text:
Aisha: Heads up — woke up to a sprinkle that turned into tiny hail near 9th and Market. Caltrain heading north is slow because of a signal fault + water on the tracks, FYI.
Ben: Oof. Did it blow any umbrellas inside out? :umbrella:
Carmen: Hail?! I left my bike outside. Gonna be crunchy. Anyone on Caltrain who can confirm delays?
DevBot: System alert: CALTRAIN_N: 15-25 min delay between Millbrae and 4th & King due to weather-related signal issue. https://caltrain.com/status
Lee: Just passed through 22nd St — concrete puddles and tiny ice pellets, trains are crawling. Announcements said single-track for a bit.
Aisha: Thanks @Lee — rerouting my morning meeting to async. Also saw a mall parking lot with a parade of soggy ducks, will preserve evidence for morale.
Ben: Photo or it didn't happen :camera_with_flash:
Carmen: If anyone's stuck and wants coffee, @Aisha said there are extra passes at the office desk. Ping me and I'll bring it down in 30.
Lee: Appreciated. I'm fine but watching the timeline. Hoping this clears before noon.
Aisha: Quick poll — who might need a ride later? Reply with :raised_hand: if so. (planning logistics for folks with long commutes)
Ben: :raised_hand:
Carmen: not me
Lee: maybe, depends if Caltrain goes into 'snooze mode' :sleeping:
DevBot: Reminder: office temperature set to 68F today. Bring layers after hail. :thermometer:
Aisha: Okay looks like 3 potential riders. @Ben @Lee — DM me your exit points and I'll see if a carpool works.
Carmen: Also, heads up for scooter people — several scooters were tipped over near Valencia & 18th, be careful parking.
Ben: Yikes. Good call.
Lee: Thanks all. If there's a big cleanup, I'll volunteer after my meeting. Duck photo incoming in #memes later. :duck:
Aisha: Thanks everyone. Stay dry and safe. Keep using this thread if you see updates or think you need a ride.
